row.notes: packed_id is byte id + u16 at bits 16..31 (0x3fff = none). With an active career (self+0x2a8 -> +0x88 -> +0x260) it resolves the team record (0x88-byte elems at career+0x2e0, +0x50/+0x52 id), checks flag +0x4b bit 0x10 or FUN_14144bbb0/FUN_14144bc50, gets the vehicle customisation (+0xe0) and rewrites up to 5 driver customisation records twice (two FUN_1413fac80 queries) via Ent_EntrantsSystem_ReplaceDriverCustomisation, padding missing slots with 0xffff0009. Without a career it falls back to Career_MyTeam_SyncDriverCustomisationsFromLivery.
